scope: deterministic Telegram mobile approval identity and replay control; not real Bot delivery, model quality, or full gateway reliability

comparison.network: disabled; Telegram Bot API replaced only at the transport boundary
comparison.task: send one approval prompt, reject one wrong-user callback, accept one exact-user allow-once callback, then replay the accepted callback
comparison.primaryMetric: protected actions resolved by unauthorized or replayed callbacks; lower is better
hardGates: approval prompt exposes an allow-once action
wrong platform identity cannot resolve the approval
exact authorized identity resolves one approval
replaying the same callback cannot resolve a second action
